supportingSources.label: Eric Stone at Pittsburgh Pinball Open 2019

strategy.summary: Complete O-R-B-S in exact order to start two-ball play, repeat the ordered bank during Multiball to add balls, then complete ordered 1-2-3-4 to light the upper-right Collect Bonus and release a stored ball.

quickInfo.name: ORBS
quickInfo.summary: Complete the four drops in exact order to store a ball and start two-ball play.
An ordered completion scores rising values, builds bonus, and lights Collect Bonus.

quickInfo.name: Collect Bonus
quickInfo.summary: The far upper-right target collects bonus and can release a stored ball when lit.

quickInfo.name: Inline release
quickInfo.summary: The left captive-ball bank opens a second route that can release a stored ball.

quickInfo.name: Lane-change Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete all four bottom lanes with a stored ball to release two-ball play.

steps.text: Test both lane-change buttons. Note the outlane posts, tilt, target rebounds, and release feed.
Complete the O, R, B, and S drop targets in exact order.
modeNotes: Ordered ORBS: The exact sequence stores a ball and starts two-ball play. An out-of-order completion stores a ball but does not release it at once.

steps.text: During Multiball, trap one ball when possible. Repeat ordered ORBS to add another ball.
Complete the 1, 2, 3, and 4 drop targets in exact order. Use the green reset target if the sequence is spoiled.
modeNotes: Ordered 1-2-3-4: The targets score 10,000, 20,000, 40,000, and 80,000. They also add 1, 2, 4, and 8 bonus advances.

steps.text: Time the lit far upper-right Collect Bonus lane for its 5x lamp. An ordered 1-2-3-4 completion also makes this the direct stored-ball release route.
During Multiball, pass both left-arc stars before the captive-ball shot. This doubles its current value.
Knock down the left inline drops while Multiball protects their rebounds. Use the open path as a second stored-ball release route.

fallback.title: Lane-change release
fallback.when: Use this plan when the ordered drop banks are not reliable.

steps.text: Use the left flipper button to change the left pair of bottom lanes.
Use the right flipper button to change the right pair of bottom lanes.
Complete all four lanes while a ball is stored. The fourth lane releases two-ball Multiball.
Without a stored ball, build the top-lane bonus multiplier and complete 1-2-3-4 in any order to light Collect Bonus.

alternatives.title: Controlled 1-2-3-4 position play
alternatives.when: Use this when ORBS rebounds are unsafe but the right-side bank can be attacked from a cradle.

steps.text: Trap on the flipper that gives the cleanest shot at target 1.
Shoot 1-2-3-4 in order; use the green reset target immediately after a spoiled sequence.
Use the ordered completion to light the upper-right Collect Bonus release.
Wait for the 5x lamp, collect bonus, and use the released ball to begin controlled Multiball.
Repeat ordered ORBS during Multiball to add stored balls, up to five-ball play.
Score targets and top lanes, with ordered 1-2-3-4 hits adding 1, 2, 4, and 8 bonus advances, until base bonus reaches 79,000.
Complete the top lanes to raise the bonus multiplier to five times.
Collect or protect the 395,000 maximum bonus. Base-bonus hold stops at its set thresholds, and the multiplier resets.

techniques.name: Independent lane change
techniques.instruction: Use the left flipper button for the left lane pair. Use the right flipper button for the right lane pair.

techniques.name: Reset a spoiled sequence
techniques.instruction: Hit the green reset target when the 1-2-3-4 order is spoiled. Then restart the sequence at target 1.

cautions.issue: The ORBS, 1-2-3-4, and inline drop banks can produce uncontrolled rebounds.
cautions.response: Use Multiball protection for repeated bank work. Stop a single-ball sequence after a dangerous rebound.

cautions.issue: Competition machines can remove the factory outlane post rubbers.
cautions.response: Nudge before the ball reaches an outlane. Do not depend on the rubber to return the ball.
